definition: A statement provided by a partnership to each partner reporting that partner's distributive share of partnership income, deductions, credits, and other tax items for the tax year.

includes.text: Reports this document and deductions from partnership operations
Contains sections for ordinary business income, rental income, capital gains, and other income items
Includes information about the partnership and the individual partner
Reports distributions made to the partner during the tax year

excludes.text: Does not report the partnership's total income or consolidated tax liability
excludes.quote: Although the partnership generally isn't subject to income tax

excludes.text: Does not include the partnership's complete tax return with all partners' shares combined

excludes.text: Does not report only one shareholder's allocable share of S corporation income

discriminators.text: Reports each partner's share of partnership income with multiple partners receiving separate statements; the sibling reports a single shareholder's share of S corporation income
Reports distributive shares allocated among multiple partners; the sibling is a corporate tax return reporting the corporation's own tax liability
This is the partner's statement of their individual share; the sibling is the partnership's own return filed with the IRS
